# Md Siam (SP Siam Ahmed)

> Md Siam, known online as SP Siam Ahmed, is a Full Stack Web Developer from Bangladesh. He builds modern, responsive websites and web applications with React, Next.js, Node.js and Firebase.

## SEO

This site is plain static HTML on purpose — every word is in the first HTML
response, so search engines do not need JavaScript to read it. It includes a
meta description, Open Graph and Twitter cards, a canonical URL, Person
JSON-LD schema, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt.
